title: Chili con carne
description: Minced beef, beans and peppers in a smoky, gently spicy tomato sauce. Doubles easily for the freezer.
steps: Fry the chopped onions and peppers in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the beef and brown it.
Stir in the garlic, spices and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans, salt and 200 ml water. Simmer 35 minutes until thick.
Serve with rice and a spoon of sour cream.

title: Sweet potato and black bean burrito bowls
description: Roasted sweet potato, black beans, corn, rice and avocado with lime and salsa. Plant-based and filling.
steps: Heat the oven to 210 °C. Cube the sweet potatoes, toss with oil, cumin, paprika and salt and roast 25 minutes.
Cook the rice. Warm the drained beans and corn in a pan with a splash of water.
Mash or slice the avocado with lime juice.
Fill bowls with rice, shredded lettuce, beans, corn, sweet potato, avocado and salsa.

title: Fish tacos with crunchy slaw
description: Spiced white fish in warm tortillas with cabbage slaw, avocado and a lime yogurt sauce.
steps: Shred the cabbage and grate the carrot. Mix with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Mix the yogurt with the rest of the lime juice.
Rub the fish with the spices and salt and fry in the oil for 3 minutes a side. Break into chunks.
Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, avocado and yogurt sauce.

title: Bean and cheese enchiladas
description: Tortillas rolled around beans, corn and peppers, baked in tomato sauce under melted cheese.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Fry the onion and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes, add the drained beans, corn, cumin and half the salt, and crush lightly.
Season the passata with chili and the rest of the salt and spread a third in a baking dish.
Fill and roll the tortillas, lay them in the dish, pour over the rest of the sauce and top with grated cheese.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce, with feta and bread for dipping. Works for any meal.
steps: Soften the sliced onion and peppers in the oil for 10 minutes. Add the garlic and spices.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make 8 hollows and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook gently 6 to 8 minutes until the whites set.
Scatter with feta and parsley and serve from the pan with bread.

title: Baked falafel bowls with tahini yogurt
description: Herby chickpea falafel baked in the oven, with couscous, salad and a lemony tahini yogurt sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Blitz the drained chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, spices, flour and 1 tsp salt into a rough paste.
Shape into 20 small patties, brush with 2 tbsp oil and bake 25 minutes, turning once.
Pour 300 ml boiling water over the couscous with the rest of the salt and oil, cover for 5 minutes and fluff up.
Mix the yogurt, tahini and half the lemon juice. Serve the falafel on couscous with diced tomato and cucumber and the sauce.

title: Mujaddara (lentils and rice with crispy onions)
description: Brown lentils and rice cooked with cumin, topped with sweet crispy onions and served with yogurt salad.
steps: Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 15 minutes. Drain.
Slice the onions thinly and fry them slowly in the oil for 25 minutes until deep brown. Take out half for the top.
Add the rice, cumin, cinnamon, salt, lentils and 500 ml water to the pan. Cover and cook 18 minutes on low heat.
Mix the yogurt with the grated cucumber. Serve the lentils topped with the crispy onions and the yogurt.

title: Chicken shawarma traybake
description: Spiced chicken thighs and onions roasted on one tray, with rice, salad and garlic yogurt.
steps: Mix 100 g yogurt with the spices, half the garlic, the lemon juice, oil and salt. Coat the chicken and leave 10 minutes or overnight.
Heat the oven to 220 °C. Spread the chicken and onion wedges on a tray and roast 30 to 35 minutes until charred at the edges.
Cook the rice. Mix the rest of the yogurt with the rest of the garlic.
Slice the chicken and serve with rice, chopped tomato and cucumber, and the garlic yogurt.

title: Beef kofta with bulgur tabbouleh
description: Spiced beef kofta with a fresh parsley, tomato and bulgur salad and garlic yogurt.
steps: Pour 400 ml boiling water over the bulgur, cover and leave 15 minutes. Drain if needed.
Mix the beef with the grated onion, half the garlic, the spices and 1 tsp salt. Shape into 12 long kofta.
Grill or pan-fry the kofta for 10 to 12 minutes, turning.
Mix the bulgur with chopped parsley, tomato, cucumber, lemon juice, oil and the rest of the salt. Serve with the kofta and yogurt mixed with the rest of the garlic.

title: Chickpea and pumpkin tagine with couscous
description: Moroccan-style stew of pumpkin and chickpeas with cinnamon, cumin and raisins. Vegan and warming.
steps: Soften the chopped onions in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and spices.
Add the peeled pumpkin in chunks, the tomatoes, drained chickpeas, raisins, salt and 300 ml water.
Cover and simmer 25 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Pour 300 ml boiling water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff and serve with the tagine and parsley.

title: Chicken soup with noodles
description: Clear Sunday chicken soup with root vegetables and thin noodles. The chicken makes a second meal.
steps: Put the chicken in 3 litres of cold water, bring slowly to a simmer and skim off the foam.
Add the whole vegetables and onion, salt and pepper. Simmer very gently for 1.5 hours.
Strain the soup. Slice the carrots back into it and take the meat off the bones.
Cook the noodles in the soup for a few minutes. Serve with parsley and some of the chicken.

title: Pumpkin soup with crispy chickpeas and feta
description: Velvety roasted pumpkin soup topped with spiced crispy chickpeas, feta and pumpkin seed oil.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C. Roast the peeled pumpkin and potato chunks with 2 tbsp oil for 30 minutes.
Toss the drained chickpeas with paprika and the rest of the oil and roast on another tray for 20 minutes until crisp.
Soften the onion and garlic in a pot, add the roasted vegetables, the stock cube and 1 litre of water, simmer 5 minutes and blend.
Serve topped with the chickpeas, crumbled feta and a few drops of pumpkin seed oil, with bread.

title: Pork chops with mash and braised sauerkraut
description: Pan-fried pork chops with creamy mashed potato and sauerkraut softened with onion and a little sugar.
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes 20 minutes, then mash with the warm milk, butter and a pinch of salt.
Fry the onion in 1 tbsp oil, add the rinsed sauerkraut, sugar, paprika and a splash of water and braise 20 minutes.
Season the chops with salt and fry in the rest of the oil 4 minutes a side. Rest 3 minutes.
Serve the chops with the mash and sauerkraut.

title: Oven chicken wings with wedges and coleslaw
description: Sticky paprika and honey wings and crispy potato wedges from the oven, with a light yogurt coleslaw.
steps: Heat the oven to 210 °C. Toss the wings with paprika, garlic powder, 1 tbsp oil and half the salt and spread on a tray.
Toss potato wedges with the rest of the oil and salt on a second tray. Roast both for 40 minutes, turning once.
Mix the honey and soy, brush over the wings and roast 5 minutes more.
Shred the cabbage, grate the carrot and mix with the yogurt and mayonnaise.

title: Turkey burgers with sweet potato fries
description: Juicy turkey burgers with garlic and herbs in soft buns, with oven-baked sweet potato fries and salad.
steps: Heat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the sweet potatoes into fries, toss with 2 tbsp oil and half the salt and bake 25 to 30 minutes.
Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, herbs and the rest of the salt and shape into 4 burgers.
Fry the burgers in the rest of the oil for 5 to 6 minutes a side until cooked through.
Serve in the buns with lettuce, tomato and ketchup, with the fries.
